prompt: What is the gross margin for each product — retail price minus supplier cost?
Find the top 5 customers by lifetime spending.
schema_only_sql:
SELECT c.id, c.cust_nm, SUM(o.ord_amt) AS lifetime_spending
FROM custs c
JOIN ords o ON c.id = o.cust_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.cust_nm
ORDER BY lifetime_spending DESC
LIMIT 5;
semantic_sql:
SELECT c.id, c.cust_nm, SUM(o.ord_amt) AS lifetime_spending
FROM custs c
JOIN ords o ON c.id = o.cust_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.cust_nm
ORDER BY lifetime_spending DESC
LIMIT 5;

prompt: Which root-level categories have no sub-categories?
ambiguous: no sub-categories → no row references this id as par_id
schema_only_sql:
SELECT c1.id, c1.name 
FROM cats c1 
LEFT JOIN cats c2 ON c1.id = c2.par_id 
WHERE c1.par_id IS NULL AND c2.id IS NULL;
semantic_sql:
SELECT id, name 
FROM cats 
WHERE par_id IS NULL 
AND id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT par_id FROM cats WHERE par_id IS NOT NULL);

Show the total number of units sold per product.

FROM prods p
JOIN rvws r ON p.id = r.prod_id

semantic_sql:

prompt: What is the total revenue from orders that are in progress (not yet cancelled)?
Find customers who have placed more than one order.

FROM custs

prompt: Which suppliers provide products in more than one product category?
schema_only_sql:
SELECT s.id, s.name
FROM sups s
JOIN prod_sup ps ON s.id = ps.sup_id
JOIN prods p ON ps.prod_id = p.id
JOIN cats c ON p.cat_id = c.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 1;
semantic_sql:
SELECT s.id, s.name
FROM sups s
JOIN prod_sup ps ON s.id = ps.sup_id
JOIN prods p ON ps.prod_id = p.id
JOIN cats c ON p.cat_id = c.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 1;

prompt: Find all customers from Ho Chi Minh City who have at least one shipped order.

FROM custs c
JOIN ords o ON c.id = o.cust_id
WHERE c.city = 'Ho Chi Minh City' AND o.sts_cd = 'shipped';
semantic_sql:

prompt: What is the average rating given by each customer?
Show the total order value per category.
ambiguous: per category → cat_id via prods via ord_lines
schema_only_sql:
SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(o.ord_amt) AS total_order_value
FROM cats c
JOIN prods p ON c.id = p.cat_id
JOIN ord_lines ol ON p.id = ol.prod_id
JOIN ords o ON ol.ord_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.name;
semantic_sql:
SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(o.ord_amt) AS total_order_value
FROM cats c
JOIN prods p ON c.id = p.cat_id
JOIN ord_lines ol ON p.id = ol.prod_id
JOIN ords o ON ol.ord_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.name;

prompt: List products where the retail price is at least double the supplier cost.
schema_only_sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.prc, ps.sup_prc
FROM prods p
JOIN prod_sup ps ON p.id = ps.prod_id
WHERE p.prc >= 2 * ps.sup_prc;
semantic_sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.prc, ps.sup_prc
FROM prods p
JOIN prod_sup ps ON p.id = ps.prod_id
WHERE p.prc >= 2 * ps.sup_prc;

prompt: What is the average transaction value of shipped orders?

prompt: Find products where the gross margin exceeds 50 percent.
schema_only_sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.prc, ps.sup_prc
FROM prods p
JOIN prod_sup ps ON p.id = ps.prod_id
WHERE (p.prc - ps.sup_prc) / p.prc > 0.5;
semantic_sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.prc, ps.sup_prc, (p.prc - ps.sup_prc) / p.prc * 100 AS gross_margin
FROM prods p
JOIN prod_sup ps ON p.id = ps.prod_id
WHERE (p.prc - ps.sup_prc) / p.prc > 0.5;
